name: shared-config
description: Shared tooling configuration for chewygumxx repositories

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run lint:md && bun run lint:yaml && bun run lint:toml
scripts.format: biome format --write . && bun run format:yaml && bun run format:toml
scripts.lint:md: git ls-files -z '*.md' | xargs -0 -r remark --frail --quiet --no-stdout && git ls-files -z '*.md' | xargs -0 -r markdownlint-cli2
scripts.lint:toml: git ls-files -z '*.toml' | xargs -0 -r tombi format --check --offline -- && git ls-files -z '*.toml' | xargs -0 -r tombi lint --error-on-warnings --offline --
scripts.lint:yaml: git ls-files -z '*.yaml' '*.yml' | xargs -0 -r prettier --check && git ls-files -z '*.yaml' '*.yml' | xargs -0 -r yamllint --strict
